doc: FAST-TRACK 11-03 (the human's playtest: the seagull/storm scene's fights used the normal sunny backdrop and never showed the Undertow). BattleStorm (game/vfx/battle/battle_storm.gd) turns a storm fight's arena into its storm variant at spawn, battle-side, without touching the arena scenes: the sky (a storm environment, or the arena sky's own shader turned overcast with sky_params), a dimmer cooler sun, rain streaks and wind-blown spray over the field, and the Undertow (UndertowStorm, an undertow.json preset) standing in the background, in the battle camera's view (azimuth from the rest frame's look, plus yaw_offset_deg). Its lightning never flashes the screen (the battle flash safety contract): exposure_flash off. fights: encounter -> look. Colours are palette.json swatches. docs/kb/tech/battle_status_looks.md (Storm fights).
fights_doc: act1-chapters' storm table decides (encounters.json `storm: true`; arenas.json storm): Ch1 C1-13/C1-14 (the scuttlers, Hullgnaw), Ch8 B10-B16 (the three stair holds, the Reach), Ch16 B09 (the storm wakes over the Choir). Ch8's headland fights and the flue moths come before the storm (B05 < B07): not storm fights. The Lead (11-03, big47): ONE Undertow per fight. A storm arena with its own Undertow (arenas.json storm.arenas: the seawall arenas, env-art's oruvel_raft_storm once built) owns the sky, wet surfaces and the vortex; BattleStorm then adds only wind and spray, plus rain when the arena's storm brings none (act1_gpu_qa row 72: double rain hid the party). On an arena without one (storm.pending's interims) BattleStorm draws the full look, its own Undertow included. tests/unit/test_battle_storm.gd: no storm fight draws two Undertows.

rising.sky_note: env-art's Oruvel storm grade (the zone's own after the Rising), as the field shows it.

reach.note: The Reach keeps its own night key, boss lights and the arena's rain (act1_gpu_qa row 72: more rain hid the party's turns); the storm adds a little wind and the Undertow behind.

choir_wakes.note: Ch16 B09 on the interim drowned_choir_ring (storm.pending): the storm wakes early over the singers. The fallback's own Undertow and sky until env-art's drowned_choir_storm lands.

looks_doc: yaw_offset_deg stays inside the frame (the rest frame's half field of view is about 40 deg across). The storm keeps its preset's distance: its bound is about 16 km, so nearer than that the battle stands inside its envelope (a probe at 7 km drew a black wall).
